Definition: a bald spot (on the back of the head); figuratively, a threadbare spot (on the back side of the cloth)
BiblicalUsage: The bald spot is the priest's problem: if there be in the bald head or bald forehead a white reddish sore, it is a leprosy sprung up, and the priest shall look upon it, and if the plague have not changed his colour, it is unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the leprosy law as God's care for the body's wholeness, and the priest as the one who must look closely and tell the truth.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
